messages:
ashley: FYI CI premerge failed: SAST job ran but attachments are empty and DAST couldn't attach because artifact decrypts returned 403. PR is blocked. Anyone available to triage?

bryan: On it. Seeing repeated keystore.decrypt 403s in the infra logs for serviceAccount:ci-runner. Possible RBAC drift after a recent IAM cleanup. @sec-oncall are you seeing any recent role changes?

sec-oncall: I'm pulling audit trail now. Creating ticket SEC-INC-2026-088. Quick thought: avoid wide ephemeral roles; prefer re-adding the missing binding. Will report back.

ci-bot: build/98765 SAST job: artifacts: 0 attachments found, status=blocked. DAST job waiting for artifact decrypt.

dora: If we reapply the binding 'artifact-scanner-access' to ci-runner that should unblock. Is there risk of drift repeating? We should log the exact change and why it was rolled back/removed.

infra-bot: audit.log query results (excerpt):
```
timestamp=2026-04-19T09:12:04Z
actor=infra-service@redwood-infer.internal
action=iam.binding.remove
binding=artifact-scanner-access
target=project:redwood-prod
request_id=req-7712
```
Looks like an automated cleanup job removed the binding.

bryan: That cleanup job is the monthly iam-prune cron. It has a safety window but apparently removed a binding that still had an active service account. We'll need to update the prune whitelist.

sec-oncall: Plan: 1) Reapply binding to ci-runner now (narrow grant). 2) Mark incident and attach audit log id. 3) Add guard in prune job to skip bindings referenced by active CI service accounts. Approve ephemeral grant only if reapply fails.

ci-bot: iam.binding.add applied by sec-oncall to 'artifact-scanner-access' for serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod. Running decrypt smoke test...

ci-bot: keystore.decrypt smoke test => OK. Re-triggering SAST/DAST pipeline: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/98765/rerun

ashley: Confirmed SAST attachments now present and DAST evidence attached to the PR. Unblocking merge. Thanks.

sec-oncall: Incident SEC-INC-2026-088 created and resolved after fix. Audit entry id=alog-2026-04-19-71f. Logged steps and who applied binding.

dora: Follow-ups: (a) Add a premerge CI gate that runs keystore.decrypt on a known test blob and fails with a clear remediation message if 403; (b) Update iam-prune whitelist to include outputs from 'ci service account inventory' job; (c) Update the runbook to include exact log query to pull the prune job request_id and binding change.

bryan: Also propose SAST policy change: if scanner attachments are empty, fail the merge with a link to the incident runbook. That prevents silent merges when evidence is missing.

ashley: I'll take the CI gate (ticket sdlc#1202). Bryan, can you file the SAST policy change (sdlc#1203)? Dora, infra-prune update ticket?

dora: Filed infra#452 (prune whitelist update) and added tests. Also added a unit test to the prune job that simulates active service accounts.

sec-oncall: Adding a metric alert: keystore.decrypt 403 rate > 2 in 5m triggers a pager and includes direct link to audit.log query + remediation steps.

infra-bot: ci rerun completed: all checks green. PR unblocked. :white_check_mark:

ashley: Thanks team. Small postmortem: root cause = automated iam-prune removed binding still required by CI. Remediation = whitelist + premerge keystore check + SAST attachment policy. Closing SEC-INC-2026-088.

sec-oncall: Closing incident in tracker and recording lessons learned. Audit log saved (alog-2026-04-19-71f). Will follow up in the next security retro.
